financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private placement of Series A Preferred Stock with warrant to Lincoln Park Capital Fund (gross subscription amount; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: an aggregate of 3,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share, together with a warrant to purchase up to an aggregate of 1,623,008 shares of common stock of the Company at an exercise price of $0.2033 per share

warrants.quote: the Company issued warrants to the Lender and its affiliates, or the Warrants, which are exercisable for an aggregate of 176,679 shares of the Company’s common stock with a per share exercise price of $2.83.
The warrant is immediately exercisable and has a term ending on February 3, 2028.
